evidence: Workbook Quality Checks!A54:D54 defines distinct authorship; Internal Quality Checks!A54:D54 has no special annotation. The frozen brief asks for a JavaScript/complete-HTML playground, a long one-line experiment, formatting, running beside source, and keeping working versions without losing a stale-tab draft (task/instruction.md:1-3). The product-specific notes define filename-selected JS/HTML execution and a side-by-side preview/console (task/environment/instructions/overview.md:3-5), semantic colouring and format-preserving runtime meaning (ui.md:13-17), authored error lines, last-good visual state, five-second stop/supersession and revision-safe snippets (behaviour.md:3-11), and an isolated preview boundary (security.md:3-5). These are concretely graded by cw_js_semantic_coloring, cw_html_semantic_coloring, cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo, cw_html_format_semantics_and_undo, cw_html_preview, cw_error_message_and_line, cw_last_good_recovery, cw_timeout_stop_and_supersession and cw_preview_boundary (task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:108-189). The closest sibling PatchPad is a long incident-report editor seeded from incident_seed.json with editor/revision/conflict workflows (projects/patchpad-editor-v3/instruction.md:3-11; environment/assets/instructions/overview.md:3-20; editing.md; persistence.md). There is genuine overlap in custom editing and save history, but renaming PatchPad records to snippets while leaving its report editor behavior intact would fail the candidate?s authored-code execution, preview and formatting outcomes. Conversely, a custom DOM/canvas JS/HTML playground with working preview and snippets is within this brief even if its UI and storage routes differ from PatchPad. The frozen template is placeholder text (rules/projects/webdev-task-template/instruction.md:1; environment/instructions/notes.md:1), and task.toml:5-15 names the code-playground slice and explicitly records adaptation from the supplied Colderwater task. This is an authored product variant, not a nouns-swapped sibling clone. No live runtime test is needed to decide this source-comparison row; this Pass makes no claim about judge or portal results.
